summary: Ron DeSantis represented Florida in Congress from 2013 to 2018, won the governorship in 2018 with Trump's endorsement and Susie Wiles's help, and was reelected in 2022. He challenged Trump for the 2024 nomination, dropped out after Iowa in January 2024 and endorsed him. His term ends in January 2027 and he has not ruled out a 2028 run.
